title: harvest matches PRD-NNN in an origin as a whole token, any repo prefix
body:
**Chose:** an idea belongs to a feature when its origin holds `PRD-NNN` as a whole token (`PRD-0070` and `PRD-007x` do not match), whatever words precede it.
**Over:** also refusing a run origin whose repo prefix (`cody-agent PRD-026 run …`) names another repo.
**Because:** the binary has no reliable name for the current repo (a lane's folder is `lane-N`), and the slice names only the whole-token trap. In this repo the one foreign origin, cody-agent PRD-026, would surface under a future PRD-026 harvest.
**Undo:** filter `<repo> PRD-NNN run` origins in `names` (src/docs/harvest.rs) once the project has a name to compare.

title: A home path in a binary file counts without the path-start rule
body:
**Chose:** `find_home_path` treats text holding a NUL byte as binary and reports any `/home/<name>/` or `/Users/<name>/` in it, without the path-start check.
**Over:** one path-start rule for every file, which missed 2 of this repo's 3 tracked `.pyc` files: their length byte (`E`, `R`) sits right before the path.
**Because:** the FR warns on any tracked docs file holding a home path, and the slice names the `.pyc` files as holders. In binary, a mid-path `/tmp/home/x/` can now warn; no tracked doc is shaped that way.
**Undo:** drop the `text.contains(&0)` branch in `src/paths.rs`.

title: Which tree factory retro --file reads when the file is outside a git repo
body:
**Chose:** `factory retro <run> --file <path>` reads earlier retros from the root `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` finds from the file's folder; outside any repository it falls back to that folder, which finds no tracked retro and writes "No earlier retro in this repo." (`src/cli/retro.rs`).
**Over:** failing the command when the file is not inside a repository.
**Because:** `--file` exists to write a retro anywhere; the comparison is a courtesy and should not make the rewrite fail.
**Undo:** replace `unwrap_or_else` with `?` in `src/cli/retro.rs`.

title: after slice-07
body:
**Covers:** slices 01, 02, 03, 04, 07
**Gate:** 1 run, 0 red, 2 min — caught: nothing
**Prove:** FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, FR-4 and the read half of FR-5 (5 of 5 rows driven; FR-5's `--done`, `docs check` and hook half is slice 05's, not built yet) — evidence: `evidence/cp-1-fr1-friction.txt`, `evidence/cp-1-fr2-evidence.txt`, `evidence/cp-1-fr3-home-paths.txt`, `evidence/cp-1-fr4-retro.txt` + `evidence/cp-1-fr4-retro.md`, `evidence/cp-1-fr5-harvest.txt`. FR-4 ran `factory retro 008-20261015-b926` on this repo over a copy of the store: Compared with lists 007 (nine cells), 006 and 005 (seven cells, padded). FR-3's `factory docs check` on this repo: 0 errors, 45 `W-HOME-PATH` warnings.
**Fixed:** leaks: src/docs/harvest.rs:114 (comment dropped), leaks: src/docs/harvest.rs:134-138 and :143 (test strings use `TKT-007` and a plain retro heading); inner loop green after.

title: factory upstream post reruns the leak check but not the issue search
body:
**Chose:** `factory upstream post` screens the draft for hits again and refuses on one, but does not repeat the open-issue search (`src/cli/upstream.rs`).
**Over:** running the whole `check`, search included, before posting.
**Because:** the search exists so the person can choose to comment instead of posting; by `post` they have chosen, and the slice's tests only constrain the issue creation.
**Undo:** call `upstream::search` in `post` before filing, and print its matches.

title: after slice-06
body:
**Covers:** slices 05, 06
**Gate:** 2 runs, 1 red, 3 min — caught: a race in `tests/lanes.rs` (`a_failing_driver_kills_and_settles_its_live_worker` broke `state.toml` before the worker's own write); fixed by the driver's gate-red commit, which waits on a marker the worker touches once parked
**Prove:** FR-5, FR-8 (2 of 2 rows driven, each as the tests' transcript plus the branch binary on a scratch repo) — evidence: `evidence/cp-2-fr5-harvest-done.txt`, `evidence/cp-2-fr8-upstream.txt`. FR-5: `harvest 001 --done` keeps exactly `log.jsonl`, `prd.md`, `retro.md`, `state.toml`, banner right after the frontmatter, home paths as `~/`, status archived; `docs check` 0 errors; `git commit` through the installed hook exit 0; a dirty folder exits 2 and moves nothing; `docs archive 002` leaves the same shape. FR-8: home path, dir name, origin owner and email each named, exit 1; one issue search per check; a clean post without `[source]` is one `issue create --repo emilianotisato/factory`; with `[source]`, one committed idea and no stub call; a failed search is one line, exit 0; `FACTORY_BOARD` refuses both with an empty stub log.
**Fixed:** none (leaks clean)
